A W Tozer Said “What comes into our minds when we think about God is the most important thing about us.”

However being pure in heart has a lot to do with our attitude towards our own personal sin. Being pure in heart begins with a realistic self awareness. It starts with the acknowledgement that we cannot stay the way we are and we need to experience the ongoing transformational power of the gospel. Salvation is more about what God is doing in our hearts in the present rather than what he did in the past.
Can you imagine living a life that has been purified from shame and guilt?
